blocks.text: CITY OF SAN FERNANDO, Philippines — Former Philippine Daily Inquirer correspondent Eric Jimenez died of complications from chronic kidney disease on Sunday, according to his family. He was 57. A graduate of Mass Communications at Angeles University Foundation in Angeles City, Jimenez wrote for and edited the newsweekly The Angeles Sun. He also served as a news correspondent for GMA News and wrote for Kapampangan Magazine. As a former president of the Pampanga Press Club, he worked to improve the well-being of its members.
